clue.text: Question attitude to Right

indicators.note: 'to' here means added on to, so the next piece is attached at the end

parts.note: a pose is a stance or attitude struck
R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone queries their stance towards the political Right.
explanation.definitionFit: A poser is a puzzling question or problem that is hard to answer.

clue.text: Inadequate telling of a story: Cinderella, for example

parts.note: inadequate work is poor
relation is the act of relating or narrating a story

explanation.surface: A critic pans a weak retelling of the Cinderella fairy tale.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes Cinderella the story being told badly; she is in fact the example the answer defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinderella is the classic example of a family member treated as inferior, the idiom for something regarded as the lesser of a group.

clue.text: Assistant dispersed followers of controversial religion

indicators.note: things dispersed are scattered about, so the word before is broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: An aide breaks up a gathering of members of a fringe cult.
explanation.definitionFit: Satanists worship Satan, a belief system widely seen as controversial.

clue.text: Weapon is thing of little value without its starter

indicators.note: losing its starter means the opening letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a trifle is something of small worth

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a weapon as a worthless object once its first part is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a long-barrelled firearm, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Service is still no good

parts.note: 'even so' means nevertheless, which is one sense of still
NG is the common abbreviation for no good

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the church service remains poor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' reads as an adverb of time, but here it is the conjunction meaning nevertheless.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the evening service of prayer in the Anglican church.

clue.text: Car part found by man to be worn out

indicators.note: one thing found beside another sits next to it, so the pieces run on in order

parts.note: the exhaust carries fumes out of a car
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: A mechanic finds a worn-out component in a car.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted means tired out or used up, a synonym of worn out.

clue.text: Gain attention by name

indicators.note: 'by' means beside, so one piece is set next to the other

parts.note: to have someone's ear is to have their attention
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A celebrity wins notice through their reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn is to gain money or reward through effort.

clue.text: Uncle cuts off plant

indicators.note: something off has gone bad or wrong, so these letters are disordered

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A gardening uncle prunes a houseplant.
explanation.definitionFit: A succulent is a fleshy plant such as a cactus that stores water in its leaves.

clue.text: Precise direction accepted as relative

indicators.note: what is accepted is taken in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: nice can mean precise or subtle, as in a nice distinction
E for east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A family member takes exact instructions on board.
explanation.walkthrough: Nice in its older sense of fine or exact, as in a nice point.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece, a brother's or sister's daughter, is a family relative.

clue.text: Not typical of one to be lacking personality

parts.note: to be out of something is to lack it
character means personality

explanation.surface: It seems uncharacteristic for someone to appear so dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaviour that is out of character is unlike a person's usual nature.

clue.text: Gradually reduce city commission for sound equipment

parts.note: to taper is to narrow or diminish bit by bit
EC is the postcode of the City of London
to commission something is to order it

explanation.surface: A council cuts the fee for its audio kit step by step.
explanation.walkthrough: The City, capitalised in Britain, is London's financial district, whose postcodes begin EC.
explanation.definitionFit: A tape recorder is an audio device for recording and playing back sound.

clue.text: Athlete has advantage, but he just fails to win

indicators.note: 'has' means holds alongside, so the second piece follows the first

parts.note: a runner is an athlete
being up, as in one up, means having an advantage

explanation.surface: A sprinter leads the race but is pipped at the line.
explanation.definitionFit: The runner-up finishes second, narrowly missing the victory.

clue.text: I have found the answer as half Europe head off takeover

indicators.note: only half the word is kept, so the second half is dropped

parts.note: taken as written before cutting

indicators.note: turned over means read the other way round
with its head off, a word loses its first letter

parts.note: taken as written before cutting
the single word is read as two, take and over, the second acting as a signal

explanation.surface: A takeover bid in Europe looks like a solution found.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's single word 'takeover' must be read as two separate words, the second of which signals turning round.
explanation.definitionFit: Eureka is Greek for 'I have found it', Archimedes' cry on discovering a solution.

clue.text: Priest's parting words

parts.note: surface reading: what a priest says as a farewell at the end of a meeting
setter's reading: parting as dying, so these are the words spoken over someone departing this life

explanation.walkthrough: Parting sounds like saying goodbye, but it means departing from life.
explanation.definitionFit: The final sacraments a priest administers to a dying person are the ritual for someone about to die.

clue.text: Funds various core users

indicators.note: various suggests varied forms, so the letters are mixed into a different order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A service is paid for by a range of its main customers.
explanation.definitionFit: Resources are stocks of money or assets available for use, synonymous with funds.

clue.text: Offered to loan glove to journalist

parts.note: a sub is an advance or small loan of money
a mitt is a glove
ED, short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: Someone proposed lending a glove to a reporter.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a sub is an advance on wages.
explanation.definitionFit: To submit something is to put it forward or present it for consideration.

clue.text: Dodge girl outside today

indicators.note: one word sits outside, wrapping around the other

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
AD, anno Domini, marks the present era we live in

explanation.surface: A young woman steps outside to avoid someone today.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade is to escape or avoid, synonymous with dodge.

clue.text: Produced the first plant outside where trees are

indicators.note: the last word goes round the outside of what precedes it

parts.note: the arum is a lily-like plant
bore is the past tense of bear, to produce

indicators.note: 'first' keeps only the opening letter of its word

parts.note: the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A gardener grew the first specimen in the open air.
explanation.definitionFit: An arboretum is a botanical garden devoted to trees.

clue.text: Duties place demands on time

indicators.note: 'on' means placed after, so one piece follows the other

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to ask a lot is to make demands

explanation.surface: Obligations make demands on our hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasks are pieces of work one has to do, much like duties.

clue.text: Dubious of putting a piece of furniture back against another

indicators.note: set against means placed up next to, so the pieces sit side by side
going back means read from end to start

parts.note: a bed is another piece of furniture
taken as written
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Someone doubts the wisdom of shoving furniture back against something else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' means another piece of furniture, which is reversed and set before the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Something debatable is open to question, so it is doubtful.

clue.text: Rotten piece of meat is the bit left over

parts.note: food that is off has gone bad
a cut is a joint or portion of meat

explanation.surface: A butcher describes a spoiled scrap of meat as a leftover.
explanation.definitionFit: An offcut is a remnant left over after cutting material.

clue.text: Funny business when service held up at church

indicators.note: 'at' puts the next piece directly alongside
in a down clue held up means turned to read from the bottom

parts.note: the RAF, Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A church service is delayed, causing a comical muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: A farce is an absurd, ludicrous situation, the funny business of the definition.

clue.text: Previously had success with other design

parts.note: a hit is a success

indicators.note: a design is a fresh arrangement, so the word before is rearranged

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: In the past someone succeeded using a different plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto means until now, so it refers to the time before the present.

clue.text: Sharpened by houseboy

parts.note: the single word is read as two, house and boy
HO is an abbreviation for house
Ned is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A knife was sharpened by the household servant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Houseboy' must be split into house and boy.
explanation.definitionFit: To hone a blade is to whet it, making it keener.

clue.text: Live without as a starting point

indicators.note: 'without' in its old sense of outside, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
taken as written

explanation.surface: A motto: live without things, as a foundation for life.
explanation.definitionFit: A base is the foundation or point from which something begins.

clue.text: Put off by dancing partner at disco

indicators.note: dancing moves things about, so the letters change places

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone was repelled by their dance partner at a nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put off' reads as repelled, but it means postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: To procrastinate is to delay or postpone action, so it means put off.

clue.text: Born English, saint perished without resting place

indicators.note: 'without' in its old sense of outside, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for born
E is the abbreviation for English
to have perished is to be dead
ST is the abbreviation for saint

explanation.surface: An obituary: an English-born saint died without a grave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resting place' suggests a grave, but it is the frame of a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedstead is the framework of a bed, where a person rests.

clue.text: Express doubts — being quiet is pointless

indicators.note: pointless means without a point, a compass bearing, so one is removed

parts.note: demure means reserved and quiet

explanation.surface: Raising objections when keeping silent is futile.
explanation.walkthrough: Points in crosswords are compass points; the final E of the six-letter word goes.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise objections or show reluctance.
